intent: Metric 3: expose the per-second rate on the daily mart for the release-day ticker

edits.new_content:
-- Metric 3, everything humanity made while waiting for GTA 6: one row per UTC day of the
-- wait, from GTA V's release (var gta_v_date) to the day before GTA 6's (var gta_6_date),
-- with that day's world real output and the running total since GTA V.
-- Days are generated here: the wait (2013 to 2026) is wider than the semantic time spine.
-- A day whose year has no output reads NULL, and so does every running total from it on.
with days as (
    select cast(range as date) as output_day
    from range(cast('{{ var('gta_v_date', '2013-09-17') }}' as date), cast('{{ var('gta_6_date', '2026-11-19') }}' as date), interval 1 day)
),

yearly as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_world_output__yearly') }}
),

daily as (
    select
        days.output_day,
        cast(year(days.output_day) as integer) as data_year,
        yearly.daily_output,
        yearly.is_estimate
    from days
    left join yearly on yearly.data_year = year(days.output_day)
)

select
    output_day,
    data_year,
    daily_output,
    daily_output / 86400 as output_per_second,
    is_estimate,
    case
        when bool_and(daily_output is not null) over wait
            then sum(daily_output) over wait
    end as cumulative_output,
    datediff('day', cast('{{ var('gta_v_date', '2013-09-17') }}' as date), output_day) + 1 as days_since_gta_v,
    datediff('day', output_day, cast('{{ var('gta_6_date', '2026-11-19') }}' as date)) as days_to_gta_6
from daily
window wait as (order by output_day rows between unbounded preceding and current row)

version: 2
models:
- name: fct_world_output_daily
  description: 'Metric 3, everything humanity made while waiting for GTA 6: world real output on each UTC day from GTA V''s release to the day before GTA 6''s, and the running total since GTA V. One row per day.'
  config:
    meta:
      dex:
        grain:
          - output_day
        population:
          rule: 'Every UTC day from var gta_v_date (2013-09-17, GTA V''s release) to the day before var gta_6_date (2026-11-19, GTA 6''s release): 4,811 days.'
        assumptions:
          - decision: Which days the wait holds
            chosen: 2013-09-17 through 2026-11-18, every UTC day
            evidence: request
            detail: 'user: bookended by the two releases; GTA 6 unlocks 2026-11-19 00:00 UTC, the site countdown''s moment'
            column: output_day
          - decision: What drives the days
            chosen: a range() of days generated in SQL, not metricflow_time_spine
            evidence: default
            detail: the time spine covers 2025-2027 only; widening it would change a model Metric 1 reads
            column: output_day
          - decision: Running total across an unavailable day
            chosen: NULL from that day on
            evidence: contract
            detail: 'AGENTS.md: a NULL is unavailable, never zero; a total that skipped a year would understate'
            column: cumulative_output
  columns:
    - name: output_day
      description: UTC day.
      config:
        meta:
          dex:
            role: time
            null_rule: never
      data_tests:
        - unique
        - not_null
    - name: data_year
      description: Calendar year of output_day.
      config:
        meta:
          dex:
            role: dimension
            null_rule: never
      data_tests:
        - not_null
    - name: daily_output
      description: World real output on the day, constant 2015 US$ (the year spread evenly).
      config:
        meta:
          dex:
            role: measure
            null_rule: NULL when the year's output is unavailable.
            aggregation: sum
            additivity: additive
            unit: currency:USD
    - name: output_per_second
      description: 'daily_output / 86400: the rate the world makes things at on the day, a yearly average spread evenly.'
      config:
        meta:
          dex:
            role: measure
            null_rule: NULL when daily_output is.
            aggregation: max
            additivity: non_additive
            unit: currency:USD
    - name: is_estimate
      description: True when the day's year is carried by IMF growth.
      config:
        meta:
          dex:
            role: attribute
    - name: cumulative_output
      description: Running total of daily_output from GTA V's release through the day. Never sum it across days.
      config:
        meta:
          dex:
            role: measure
            null_rule: 'NULL from the first day with unavailable output on: never a partial total.'
            aggregation: max
            additivity: semi_additive
            unit: currency:USD
    - name: days_since_gta_v
      description: 1 on GTA V's release day, 4,811 on 18 Nov 2026.
      config:
        meta:
          dex:
            role: attribute
            null_rule: never
            unit: days
      data_tests:
        - not_null
    - name: days_to_gta_6
      description: Days left until GTA 6's release day; 1 on 18 Nov 2026.
      config:
        meta:
          dex:
            role: attribute
            null_rule: never
            unit: days
      data_tests:
        - not_null
